caption: A parked bicycle casts a sharp shadow on a sunny wall, and a passing cloud makes the shadow fade and then return.

sa.check: A parked bicycle casts a sharp shadow on a sunny wall.
The cloud comes first, then the fade, then the return.

pc.expect: The shadow softens and vanishes as the cloud covers the sun and comes back in the same place when the sun returns.
pc.fail: It stays sharp with the sun covered; or returns in a different place; or fades with the sun still shining.

pc.expect: The fade and return follow the cloud smoothly.
pc.fail: The shadow flickers; or snaps off and on; or fades and never returns in sunlight.
It rolls; or tips; or its shadow moves while it stands.

pc.expect: The returned shadow is the same bicycle outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or is missing the wheels.
A second bicycle appears; or the shadow becomes solid; or the bike vanishes.

pc.expect: The bicycle and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The bike changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
